text: I do not need this right now, but I am interested next month. Please tell me the current price; do not book anything or call this a permanent rejection.

No problem at all, we are happy to help you next month as well. A basic bicycle service costs four hundred ninety nine rupees, and a puncture repair costs one hundred twenty rupees. Parts are extra only after approval. Would you like to know anything else about our services?
Yes, I am still interested in future. I am not asking you to call me later right now. What should I know about the service?

A puncture repair costs one hundred twenty rupees, and any parts needed will be extra only after your approval. Would you like to share your preferred name and locality so we can note this for next month?
You have answered my questions. I do not need anything else. Goodbye, end the call.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
